| description = Hits in the high 100s, summons. Highly magic resistant. Spawns on crest of hill in between Gfay and Steamfont zones. Take a diagonal path from either zoneline to the other and you should see the ridge that it spawns on, if not the unicorn itself.

He is on either Faydarks Champions or Soldiers of Tunare faction (probably Soldiers). These factions can be raised with the [[Muffin for Pandos]] quest.

Hand him the [[Kedge Cave Crystals]] that drops from the [[Corrupted Seahorse]] in [[Kedge Keep]], the [[Ocean of Tears Seavines]] looted from a [[Corrupted seafury cyclops]] in the [[Ocean of Tears]], and the [[Green Heartwood Branch]] obtained from destroying the [[Corrupted brownie]] found in [[Lesser Faydark]] to receive his [[Gleaming Unicorn Horn]]. The pained unicorn will not despawn like the other NPCs in this quest. You must then take the horn to [[Silox Azrix]] found in [[Ak'Anon]] (2009, -2620) to receive the [[Cleansed Spirit of Faydwer]]
*Turn in did not work at level 35. Make sure he responds to the quest text.
*Sneak turn in with indifferent confirmed to work.
